bagPolicy.summary: Riyadh Air Metropolitano states no bag size, but suitcases, baby strollers, umbrellas and helmets are not allowed.
bagPolicy.note: A cloakroom is available for items you cannot take inside; no price is listed. The stadium's rules apply to all events, including concerts, but promoters may add their own rules. Club rules also ban objects over 500 g that could be thrown.

parking.note: Parking information is not directly accessible from the provided URL. Visitors are advised to check local resources or contact the venue for detailed parking options and pricing.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Riyadh Air Metropolitano's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Riyadh Air Metropolitano varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Riyadh Air Metropolitano, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Riyadh Air Metropolitano's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Riyadh Air Metropolitano. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Riyadh Air Metropolitano. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
